name: Gallery
description: Rich component: pictures in a view, drawn as a note's image lines are. gallery:: shows the notes under it as cards with their [cover::] picture; pic:: shows one picture.

handlers.description: The notes under this block as cards, each with its [cover::] picture
One picture, from a path the outline names

argument.name: path
argument.description: the picture's path (a note's [img::] path), or file:/path
